segments.he: צְרִיכִין לְהִתְבּוֹדֵד וּלְדַבֵּר אֶל נַפְשׁוֹ מִתַּכְלִית עוֹלָם הַבָּא
segments.en: And it is already well known that one must never despair of crying out. For even if one has sinned greatly, very greatly, and even if one is still as one is — if one does not despair of crying out and of prayer and supplication, one can merit the Torah's facets in truth, and even all seventy facets. For Hashem is good to all, and more than the calf wishes to nurse, He wishes to bestow upon us all good — to illuminate for us all seventy facets of the Torah. Only the awakening from below is required, and the primary need is to cry out greatly to Hashem until the totality of one's crying voices rises to the aspect of seventy cries in truth — until one merits to truly break the evil of the seventy nations, whose root is the desire mentioned above, through which one will merit the seventy facets of the Torah. For the seventy facets correspond to the seventy years which are the totality of a person's life — and corresponding to them are the seventy cries, which must be cried throughout all the days of one's life encompassed within those seventy years.

segments.he: הַדִּבּוּר יֵשׁ לוֹ כּחַ גָּדוֹל מְאד מְאד לַהֲפךְ אֶת הָאָדָם מֵרַע לְטוֹב. כִּי עִקַּר נִצְחוֹן הַמִּלְחָמָה הוּא עַל יְדֵי הַדִּבּוּר שֶׁהוּא עִקַּר הַכְּלִי זַיִן שֶׁל יִשְׂרָאֵל. כִּי אֵין כּחֵנוּ אֶלָּא בַּפֶּה כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה. וְזֶה עִקַּר הַכְּלִי זַיִן שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ שֶׁהוּא בְּחִינַת כָּל הַצַּדִּיקֵי אֱמֶת שֶׁבָּהֶם תְּלוּיִים וּכְלוּלִים כָּל יִשְׂרָאֵל. כִּי כָּל כְּלֵי זֵינוֹ שֶׁל מָשִׁיחַ הִיא רַק עַל יְדֵי הַתְּפִלָּה שֶׁהִיא עַל יְדֵי הַדִּבּוּר (כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּסִימָן ב' לִקּוּטֵי קַמָּא) וּכְמוֹ שֶׁכָּתוּב בְּכַמָּה מְקוֹמוֹת. וְעַל יְדֵי זֶה עִקַּר הַכְנָעַת הָרַע עַיִן שֶׁמִּמֶּנּוּ הַשִּׁכְחָה. כִּי בִּטּוּל הַשִּׁכְחָה וְלִזְכּוֹת לְזִכָּרוֹן הוּא עַל יְדֵי הַדִּבּוּר בִּבְחִינַת זָכוֹר בַּפֶּה כְּמוֹ שֶׁאָמְרוּ רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה. כְּמוֹ שֶׁרוֹאִין בְּחוּשׁ שֶׁעַל יְדֵי שֶׁחוֹזְרִין מִשְׁנָתוֹ כַּמָּה וְכַמָּה פְּעָמִים בְּפֶה מָלֵא עַל יְדֵי זֶה זוֹכְרִין לִמּוּדוֹ תָּמִיד וְכֵן לְעִנְיַן הַזִכָּרוֹן הָעִקָּרִי הַנַּ"ל שֶׁהוּא לִזְכּר תָּמִיד בְּעָלְמָא דְּאָתֵי שֶׁמִּתְגַּבֵּר כְּנֶגֶד זֶה הָרַע עַיִן שֶׁמִּמֶּנּוּ הַשִּׁכְחָה לְהַשְׁכִּיחַ מִלֵּב חַס וְשָׁלוֹם הַזִכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה. עַל כֵּן הָעֵצָה לָזֶה לַחֲזר הַזִכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה בְּדִבּוּר פִּיו לִהְיוֹת רָגִיל בְּכָל יוֹם לְדַבֵּר בְּפֶה מָלֵא מֵעִנְיַן הַזִכָּרוֹן הַזֶּה לְדַבֵּר אֶל לִבּוֹ וּלְהַזְכִּיר אֶת עַצְמוֹ בְּפֶה מָלֵא מַה יִּהְיֶה הַתַּכְלִית מִמֶּנִּי לָעוֹלָם הַבָּא. וּמַה יִּהְיֶה סוֹפִי וְכִי בָּאתִי הֵנָּה לִקְבּעַ עַצְמִי חַס וְשָׁלוֹם בְּזֶה הָעוֹלָם. הָעוֹבֵר וְהָרָץ וְהַפּוֹרֵחַ מְאד. וְלא בָּאתִי הֵנָּה כִּי אִם לְהָכִין עַצְמִי לְעָלְמָא דְּאָתֵי וְכוּ'. וּבִשְׁבִיל זֶה צְרִיכִין לִלְמד סִפְרֵי מוּסָר שֶׁנִּתְיַסְּדוּ עַל פִּי דִּבְרֵי רַבּוֹתֵינוּ זִכְרוֹנָם לִבְרָכָה בִּגְמָרָא וּמִדְרָשִׁים וְעַל פִּי צַדִּיקֵי אֱמֶת כִּי כָּל הַסִּפְרֵי מוּסָר הָאֲמִתִּיִּים מַזְכִּירִין אֶת תַּכְלִית עוֹלָם הַבָּא וְכֵן צְרִיכִין לְהִתְבּוֹדֵד בְּכָל יוֹם וּלְדַבֵּר בְּפֶה מָלֵא מִתַּכְלִית עוֹלָם הַבָּא כַּנַּ"ל. כִּי הַדִּבּוּר יֵשׁ לוֹ כּחַ גָּדוֹל לְהַזְכִּיר אֶת הָאָדָם כַּנַּ"ל.
segments.en: The essence of Hashem's truth is that His compassion and His kindnesses are never exhausted — whatever the situation, always, always, prayer and supplication and outcry and plea to Hashem are effective. This is in opposition to the truth of the angels, who according to their perception said: "What is man that You should remember him?" [Tehillim 8:5]. But the Tzaddikim — like Moshe and those who followed in his path — labored and toiled until they attained the understanding that after all the anger with which they anger Him, His true compassion is still never exhausted. And in every generation there are Tzaddikim and worthy ones who follow in their path, who strengthen themselves in prayer always — and through this they sweeten all the judgments in the world and nullify all the evil decrees against Yisrael, and bring true daas into Yisrael to strengthen themselves in prayer and supplication always. For this is the ultimate truth. As it is written: "Hashem is close to all who call Him, to all who call Him in truth" [Tehillim 145:18]. And it is written: "As for me — may my prayer come to You, Hashem... in Your great kindness, answer me with Your true salvation" [Tehillim 69:14] — in truth, specifically. For I believe truly and genuinely that even now, You still desire to save me — therefore I strengthen myself and pray: answer me in Your true salvation. And understand well, well — how very much one must strengthen oneself in prayer always, whatever the situation.

segments.he: וְזֶה בְּחִינַת מִדֵּי דַּבְּרִי בּוֹ זָכוֹר אֶזְכְּרֶנּוּ (כְּמוֹ שֶׁכָּתַבְנוּ בְּמָקוֹם אַחֵר): (שָׁם אוֹת יד):
segments.en: I heard from his holy mouth of blessed memory a wondrous conversation — one of the wonders of the greatness of the Creator — which cannot be fully set down in writing. But afterward, in the midst of his holy conversation about the greatness of the Creator, he moved from there into words of strengthening — to strengthen every single person who has fallen from their service of Hashem, wherever they have fallen. For Hashem's greatness is far above the Torah — there everything can be repaired. I asked him: "But how does one merit this?" And he answered: "One can come to it — provided one does not despair of crying out and prayer and entreaty. Only to engage in crying out and prayer and supplication — and never to tire until one comes to it, to ascend."
